svg.text: The main view. One track selected, one note lane shown at a time.
Step sequencer - 32 steps of the shown note lane
Drum pads (select lane + play) | Velocity selector
Tap a step = toggle it (entered with the selected velocity; red velocity grid = dynamic mode, hit strength is used).
Drum pads play live and pick which note lane the steps show. Hold Shift while tapping = select silently.
* Bank buttons nudge held steps instead. Tap the selected velocity again = dynamic mode (tap any level to leave it).
